doc.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23

title: A family of pianists and musicians
summary: Burns's sister, children and grandsons played music.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: Somebody else in your family playing music?
Well, my sister played a little bit piano. You got a real piano family.
Yeah. All of my kids played. All of them. We got two grandsons that played. Yeah, all of them played.
Three. Are they here? No. Oh, yeah.
New Orleans. Oh, New Orleans. One played trumpet. One played clarinet.
What did Lil Jon play? Lil Jon play sax. That's three grandsons. Then I got a, then I'll go, then, what you going to play piano too, uh, uh, uh, Barbara. Yes.
